Results.ReviewText: Webber grill is a great product.  It is superior quality, strong and sturdier than many less expensive grills.  One negative comment:  For older people, installing the full propane tank is very difficult.
Results.Title: Webber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my Weber grill a month ago and used about 4 times now. We love this grill, it heats up quickly and cooks extremely well. The cast iron grates made nice grill marks on your food and are easy to clean. We did have one issue immediately after the purchase. While assembling the grill which was very easy (the instructions were excellent), we found a crack in the grill lid. I contacted customer service and they were fantastic. Sent them a picture of the lid and in 15 minutes the representative responded back the they were replacing the lid under warranty. In a few days the new lid arrived. Weber customer support was amazing, they even registered my grill via txt which made obtaining support very easy. If you looking a great small grill for a patio or other small area. This is the one to buy. We love it and totally recommend it. You won't be disappointed!!
Results.Title: Great Small Area Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought an older version of this grill 13 years ago and couldn't be more pleased! I've had no issues with parts, everything is still original and works great! The only thing I've replaced are batteries for the ignitor. I'd definitely by another grill from this company if something happened with this one.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: It is just the right size for my needs.  I like the temperature gauge.
Results.Title: Great Bar-B-Que

Results.ReviewText: Every few years we buy a new grill because we always purchase a cheap one.  Well this year I decided to go for a quality grill.  I purchased my first Webber grill and love it.
Results.Title: Worth every penny

Results.ReviewText:
Perfect for daily family use.  Had a Q3200 for near 10 years for daily (2-5 times a week) use and Weber Genesis 3-burner for parties.  Q3200 is amazing:  quick to heat, large enough for six people, but lacked a little internal height on rack.  the E-210 is similar in footprint and has the space for more vegetables on rack (I rigged extension for more rack - I wish Weber can come up with an add-on).

If you grill multiple times a week (instead of range in kitchen), this is a perfect set-up.  If you want to do a party, you will need the larger Weber.  Large Webers are great, but are slow to heat-up, drain propane fast.  Having both (space permitting), is the best!

Oh, I am keeping the Q3200 (many updated parts over the years) as extension for parties!! ;-)
Results.Title: Perfect for daily family use

Results.ReviewText: So far I love the E-210 Weber gas grill.  The only issue I am experiencing is the tempature range with the Lid closed seems to not be much different between the High and Med temp settings.  I have to cook with the dials set to Low or close to Low to get the Tempature to come down into the 320 degree range.  Not sure if there is a way to calibrate the temp range between High and Med to get the temp to drop more between these 2 settings ?
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: I am household of one so didn’t need 3 or more burners. This heats up much faster than the infrared 2 burner it replaced. I use it for 90% steaks then burgers. Easy to assemble with pictures & abbreviated written instructions. Recommend laying all parts out on a sheet on floor in house grouped by pieces. Cut tops off of hardware bags but leave pieces in them because they’re identified by numbers/letters on bags & referenced that way in assembly instructions. Took about 1.5 hrs working alone slowly so not to make mistakes. Be sure to do the required HIGH HEAT burn off before first use, lots of smoke/smell to get rid of. Very pleased at steak results.
Results.Title: Smaller But Powerful

Results.ReviewText: I'm impressed with the quality of the parts and ease of assembly. I've onlused it twice so far but had no issues using it.
Results.Title: Spirit E210

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with this grill.  Have the same one at my other home.  Cooking area is plenty big enough for cooking and the grates are easy to clean if you keep up with regular maintenance.
Results.Title: Weber grill 200 series

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Took awhile to put together, but directions were clear and had all parts. Love the propane meter, I won’t run out. Heats up fast. On the smaller side, but you can still cooka whole dinner. Good sized cooking space.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber does makes a sweet grill. WishI hadn’t waited so long to get one.Cooks evenly and is wind resistant in blowing out the flame.
Results.Title: Weber spirit

Results.ReviewText: Much better than the grills I used to purchase. Those grills were less expensive, but I am much happier with the quality and functionality of this Weber grill. The other grills failed to give a good, smokey flavor, good grill marks, failed to cook evenly, and would corrode/ rust within just a few years.
Results.Title: Best Grill I've had.  I have been grilling for 40+

Results.ReviewText:
Perfect grill for the two of us and even those times when we have the grandkids over.  
It seems small at first but I can easily fit 12 burgers on it and with the griddle grate on it I can do smash burgers, eggs, pancakes, all sorts of food.  
It may be on the low end of the Weber spectrum but there is no low end quality.  This spirit has all the great features Weber is known for: heavy duty grates, solid heat diffusers/flavorizer bars, easy grease cleanout tray, well thought out grease flow/trap, solid body and lid.  
I would buy this over the getting the low quality grills and replacing them every 2 to 3 years.
Try one out, you won't regret it.
Results.Title: Spirit grill is amazing

Results.ReviewText:
I will not give a positive review after receiving a "re-taped" box (obviously it was not new) and the door being dented.  It was only discovered at the last step of assembly.

I was sold a damaged model; this is despicable.
Results.Title: Re-taped shipping box containers dented door.

Results.ReviewText: Recent purchase is my second Weber ever -  this one is for snowbird residence in Florida.  First Weber, about 25 years old, is still in use in other home “up north”.  This new one is performing perfectly so far here.  I hope that this one performs and lasts as well as my first. So far, so good!
Results.Title: Repeat buyer

Results.ReviewText: A good grill; just the right size for two. The propane tank mount is awkward; straight grip on a curved tank collar. The caps fell from the casters during assembly and needed to be tapped back on and glued in place. Otherwise, a good grill and I expect years of good use.
Results.Title: Just got it

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to use and fast to reach required temperature. Wonderful for quick jobs e.g. grilling a steak. On the down side, tank slightly harder to install.
Results.Title: Good friend for grilling.

Results.ReviewText: I have had this grill in my ownership for just about two years and it hands down is the best grill that I have had the privilege of using. My grandfather had this for about two years before I got it and it is still working perfect. To this day, I am still astonished at how consistent it is. I can go out to this grill and start it first press in anything from a blizzard to a tropical storm. No matter the conditions it gives an exceptional sear, and there is basically no fear of over/undercooking the food. Anyone who is thinking of purchasing this model of grill absolutely should buy it without hesitation.
Results.Title: 100% THE BEST Grill Money Buys

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size. Lights every time.  Heats up fast. Would recommend
Results.Title: Hot grill

Results.ReviewText: This small family grill is ideal for rental home. I reviewed several grills and found this little powerhouse had more btus per square inch than many grills in similar class.  Also by from a local grill stores. I made the mistake of buying one at the big box stores, and while purchasing a second one locally for my rental there are differences for the nearly the same money at the big box price point driven stores. Better quality at local store
Results.Title: Great grill better to buy local.

Results.ReviewText: crazy but I purchased another brand of grill from a big box store earlier for my new Airbnb and had it on my deck for 2 weeks --without using it once -- and noticed rusting and it was  brown bad rust so took it back and remembered my weber grill that I loved and still had after 8 years without any rust ( Oh - I am in the Caribbean and lots of salty air ) . I was able to located a Webber grill Spirit E-210 at a different store and since I needed 2 for my Airbnb -- got a second one as well. Now, i not only get compliments on my Airbnb but get compliments on the grill that I supply for my guests to use -- never thought a propane grill would make such an impact on my guests .
Results.Title: Do brands  Matter ??

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Spirit grill that I have owned.  I had the previous grill for about 15 years and I was sad when I had to retire it.  My family gave me a new one for Christmas and I am very happy to have it back!  They asked if I wanted a different grill and I said no because my old grill was perfect and I did not need a different grill.  😃
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: A perfect replacement to my previous Weber grill that lasted 14 years.
Results.Title: No substitute for quality

Results.ReviewText: A genuinely very nice grill - my son, a professional chef, gave me this grill for Christmas.  While visiting - he has used it to grilll everything from meats to pizza and vegetables.  He loves it.  Indicates it's perfect.  Food is perfectly cooked.
Results.Title: A genuinely very nice grill.

Results.ReviewText: We use our grill 4-5 times per week for dinner. The Spirit E-210 propane gas grill has proven to be durable, quick to heat up, and easy to use. For our household, the size is just right for everyday dinners but also for larger visitor groups. The grill seems very efficient on gas usage and the heat level is very even across the grilling surface.
Results.Title: Durable and easy for nearly daily use

Results.ReviewText: This product is such a joy to use.  It is easy to start and heats up really fast!  I like the ease of use and the small footprint.  Head and shoulders above other products of the same size and the quality of craftsmanship is second to none.  If you looking for a high quality and reliable grill then look no further!
Results.Title: QUALITY & DEPENDABLE GEM

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Spirit gas grill...15 years sitting on the deck and countless dinners it was time for a replace....I chose the same Spirit E-210 as the first because it has been the best grill I have ever owned...Always a great cooking experience...
Results.Title: Cooking With Gas

Results.ReviewText: The company that delivered the grill did not unpack it or set it up and check if it worked . After I set it up I had a problem heating it up so I called customer service was great she walked me through what I needed to do and got it working so far that’s my only complaint
Results.Title: Some good some not so good

Results.ReviewText: Right out the box this grill has been very impressive. High quality construction and design with outstanding performance. We are very impressed and look forward to many years of grilling fun and success.
Results.Title: Impressive high quality, design and performance.

Results.ReviewText: I have made 2 cooks with this little guy so far and it has performed wonderfully. The temperature control is very good and it is very user friendly.
Results.Title: Perfect for my wife and I. Great value.

Results.ReviewText: Downsized from a larger gas grill. The Spirit E-210 is the perfect size for two empty nesters. Still have our Weber Kettle for charcoal.
Results.Title: Perfect for two person household

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, easy to assemble, easy to use, sturdy unit that cooks food according to order. We used to have one like this previously and loved it so much we bought another after leaving the old one with the house we just sold.
Results.Title: Love this grille.

Results.ReviewText: Weber is the best! This fits perfectly in my front patio, I don’t have too much space so a “22 is just right for me. I am impressed how well it cooks and once started, heats up quickly. It’s essential for when it’s cold and I used to use charcoal all the time before and now I can just go outside and start up and grill quickly outside. Having two burners is very helpful. I am enjoying this product so far.
Results.Title: It’s just the right size

Results.ReviewText: Great size for small patio! Amazing cooking control.
Results.Title: PERFECT PATIO GRILL!!

Photos.Caption: Just some steaks and corn on the cob

Results.ReviewText: Love this barbecue. It’s not too small and not too big. It’s very space saving but also gives you that nice size grill feel. I bought a medium sized cover from Lowe’s for it. It works perfectly fine.  The grill itself is great. Gives a very nice even grill on all parts of it. It’s easy to clean. I also like how it hides the propane tank and the tank reader.
Results.Title: Great buy

Results.ReviewText: Had to flip grates to be able to flip burgers because of the ridges on grates.
Results.Title: Grates

Results.ReviewText: This was a gift for my husband.  The size is perfect for the two of us.  It heats up well and lamb chops, hamburgers and chicken have all come out great. He likes that he doesn't get a charcoal smell in his clothes and doesn't have to wait for charcoal to light etc. and is easy to use and clean.
Results.Title: new gas grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and ACE manager came and set it up and removed the old one 2 days before Christmas
Results.Title: Great grill great ACE service

Results.ReviewText: Perfect. Compact, easy to use, plenty of heat, food tasted great.
Results.Title: Just what we needed.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
